findings.title: Double-checked locking does not re-check entryPointAssetsCache after acquiring write lock
findings.body: In `GetWebAssets`, `entryPointAssetsCache` is checked under a read lock (lines 41-47), which is then released before acquiring the write lock at line 48. After acquiring `entryPointAssetsCacheMu.Lock()`, `entryPointAssetsCache` is not checked again. If multiple goroutines concurrently call `GetWebAssets` on a cold cache (when `cfg.Env != setting.Dev`), all of them will see `ret == nil` under the read lock, wait on `Lock()`, and then each one will redundantly re-read and parse `assets-manifest.json` from disk and overwrite `entryPointAssetsCache` sequentially. Re-checking `if cfg.Env != setting.Dev && entryPointAssetsCache != nil { return entryPointAssetsCache, nil }` after acquiring the write lock avoids the redundant file I/O and parsing.
